# Official Templates

Three layouts cover every GCS table use case. **Start from the matching
template below and adapt it** — swap the title/subtitle/data/footnote
text, column count, column headers and icons, row data and flag codes.
Never rebuild the wrapper structure from scratch.

The flag `src` values below use absolute `https://` URLs from the
msikma/country-flags repo — this is required for any table that will be pasted
outside this repo (WordPress, email, etc.). See `references/flags.md`.

The footer logos are inlined as SVG so they survive the same paste-out
context — see `references/icons.md` for the full SVG markup for both the
blue (light footers) and white (dark footers) variants.

---

## Template 01 — Standard Card Table

Card heading above the table, Night Blue solid header row, icons above text,
zebra rows, white footer with dark blue logo.

**Use for:** programme comparisons embedded inside an article or blog post
where the surrounding page already sets the page-level heading.

`data-theme="light"` `data-header="solid"` `data-footer="light"`

```html
<div class="gcs-table" data-theme="light" data-header="solid" data-footer="light">
```

## Template 02 — Dark Blue Card Table

Full Night Blue card wrapping a white table interior. Card heading and footer
on Night Blue; the table itself floats on white. High-contrast editorial
format for flagship data publications.

**Use for:** standalone rankings, flagship index tables, or any table that
needs to stand fully on its own as a shareable asset.

`data-theme="dark"` `data-header="minimal"` `data-card="deep"`

## Template 03 — Standard Table

text, zebra rows, white footer with dark blue logo. For use when the
surrounding page already provides editorial context.

**Use for:** tables embedded within a longer article where a dedicated card
heading block would be redundant.
